description: Lists Salesforce Note or ContentNote records using a SOQL query with filtering, sorting, and field selection. Include Id in the selected fields so returned records can be validated.

query.default: SELECT Id, Title, Body, IsPrivate, ParentId, OwnerId, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate FROM Note
query.description: SOQL query to fetch notes. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. This action is specifically designed for Note and ContentNote objects. For other objects like EmailMessage (which uses 'Subject' instead of 'Title'), use the general SOQL query action instead. Always include a LIMIT clause to avoid over-fetching; the default query has no LIMIT and may return very large payloads. Omit Body or use TextPreview (ContentNote only) when full note content is not needed.
examples: SELECT Id, Title FROM Note WHERE ParentId = '001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX'
SELECT Id, Title, Body FROM Note WHERE IsPrivate = false ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC
SELECT Id, Title, ParentId FROM Note WHERE OwnerId = '005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Title FROM Note WHERE CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH
SELECT Id, Title, TextPreview FROM ContentNote WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_WEEK
query.human_parameter_description: Provide a Salesforce SOQL query to select the notes you want to retrieve from Note or ContentNote objects. Use filters (like ParentId, OwnerId, or date) to narrow the results. Note: For querying EmailMessage objects, use the general SOQL query action instead, as EmailMessage uses 'Subject' field instead of 'Title'.
query.title: Query

name: list_notes

ListNotesResponse.description: Response schema for salesforce.list_notes action. Salesforce has two note objects: ContentNote (Lightning/Enhanced Notes, API v32.0+) and Note (Classic). Modern implementations use ContentNote.

done.description: Indicates whether all results have been returned. If false, use nextRecordsUrl to retrieve additional results.
done.title: Done

nextRecordsUrl.description: URL path to retrieve the next batch of results when pagination is needed. Only present when done is false.
nextRecordsUrl.title: Next Records Url

totalSize.description: Total number of notes returned by the query.
totalSize.title: Total Size

ListNotesResponse.title: ListNotesResponse

url.description: REST API URL for accessing the specific record.
url.title: Url

NoteRecord.description: Individual note record. Can be either ContentNote (Lightning) or Note (Classic) object.

Body.description: Text content of the note. Available in classic Note object.
Body.title: Body

Content.description: For ContentNote: Returns a URL pointing to the blob content (requires additional API call to retrieve actual content). Content must be base64 encoded when creating notes.
Content.title: Content

ContentSize.description: Size of the content in bytes. Available in ContentNote.
ContentSize.title: Content Size

CreatedById.description: ID of the user who created the note.
CreatedById.title: Created By Id

CreatedDate.description: Date and time when the note was created (ISO 8601 format).
CreatedDate.title: Created Date

FileExtension.description: File extension of the note content. Available in ContentNote.
FileExtension.title: File Extension

FileType.description: Type of file, typically 'SNOTE' for ContentNote.
FileType.title: File Type

Id.description: Unique identifier for the note record.
Id.title: Id

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the note has been deleted.
IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

IsPrivate.description: Indicates whether the note is private. Available in classic Note object.
IsPrivate.title: Is Private

IsReadOnly.description: Indicates whether the note is read-only. Available in ContentNote.
IsReadOnly.title: Is Read Only

LastModifiedById.description: ID of the user who last modified the note.
LastModifiedById.title: Last Modified By Id

LastModifiedDate.description: Date and time when the note was last modified (ISO 8601 format).
LastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

LastReferencedDate.description: Date and time when the note was last referenced, including through reports or related lists (ISO 8601 format).
LastReferencedDate.title: Last Referenced Date

LastViewedDate.description: Date and time when the note was last viewed (ISO 8601 format). Available in ContentNote.
LastViewedDate.title: Last Viewed Date

LatestPublishedVersionId.description: ID of the latest published version of the content. Available in ContentNote.
LatestPublishedVersionId.title: Latest Published Version Id

OwnerId.description: ID of the user who owns the note.
OwnerId.title: Owner Id

ParentId.description: ID of the parent record (Account, Contact, Lead, etc.) that the note is associated with. Available in classic Note object.
ParentId.title: Parent Id

SharingPrivacy.description: File privacy setting controlling who can access the note. Available in ContentNote.
SharingPrivacy.title: Sharing Privacy

SystemModstamp.description: Date and time when the note was last modified by any user or system process (ISO 8601 format).
SystemModstamp.title: System Modstamp

TextPreview.description: Preview text of the note content. Available in ContentNote.
TextPreview.title: Text Preview

Title.description: Title of the note. Available in both ContentNote and Note objects.
Title.title: Title
